scope: IOI2016 fixed six competition tasks; independent research prototypes only

molecules.verified: Positive sorted window search equals independent exact all-subset sum-set DP existence for all tested valid-width ranges. Cardinality window sums are monotone and jump by at most max−min<=u−l. Sorting retains original indices in future API.
molecules.unconfirmed: Complete reusable C++20/API/invalid/overflow/full-scale checker not created.

railroad.verified: Auxiliary maxspeed→1 edge, per-coordinate-cut balance correction and component MST equal ALL literal section orderings. Repeated endpoints/self-sections are included.
railroad.unconfirmed: No production Euler/sweep/DSU C++ API, source-scale resource/overflow/exception/sanitizer validation yet.

shortcut.verified: All actual augmented-graph Floyd diameters over EVERY legal express endpoint pair equal rotated-square constraints AND independent O(N) decision sweep. GuardK>=topTwoBranchLengths implies eligible distinct i automatically i<j; exclude self with two extrema by different indices. Keep c in all four bounds. Discrete distinct endpoints use V-shaped lower-bound pointer. Sort x−d/x+d once, then binary answer in O(NlogN+NlogDiameter).
shortcut.unconfirmed: Research prototype sorts sweep order per invocation; production must cache sorting once. No full N1million implementation, exception/64bit/sanitizer/API validation yet.

paint.verified: Prefix/suffix feasibility and per-block range marking equal color intersection/union across every literal full binary solution consistent with each observation, including mandatory black/white separation sentinels. O(NK), full K100/N200000 state bound identified.
paint.unconfirmed: No production reusable memory-bounded C++20/API, inconsistent-input policy, maximum/sanitizer validation yet.

messy.verified: Literal compile maps output bit i to original bit p[i]; restored output is p, not inverse. Fixed precompile partition masks use outside ones and one left-half marker. Different levels have different weights, same-level blocks have disjoint zero supports. Exactly one compile after all writes; reads only later; worst448writes/896reads at128 fits strict full limits.
messy.unconfirmed: No callback-template C++20/state/error/source-scale resource validation yet; character operations O(N²logN), oracle calls O(NlogN).

aliens.verified: Literal UNION of actual square cell bitmaps matches containment-filtered overlap-subtracted partition DP, monotone lower hull penalty DP, and integer penalty search. Pairwise Monge nested-edge exchange proves discrete convexity via rebalancing q−1/q+1 paths toq/q; lex encoded count selects fewer photos; integer slopes justify G(lambda)−lambda*k even count jumps.
aliens.unconfirmed: No production 1e5/N/m1e6 API/128-bit cross arithmetic/tie/maximum/sanitizer validation yet. Research DP quadratic, penalty prototype linear hull, no completed article.
